description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance for different fine-tuning methods applied to RoBERTa models of varying sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning method, labeled as “Prefix”, “Adaptor”, “LoRA”, “BitFit”, “S₁-model”, “S₂-model”, and “S₅-model”, in that order, and is categorical. The vertical axis represents GLUE performance, labeled as “GLUE Performance”, with a linear scale ranging from 84 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For each fine-tuning method, there are two bars representing the RoBERTa model size, with “base” represented by a blue bar and “large” represented by an orange bar. The “base” model bars range in height from approximately 85.2 for “Prefix” to 87.5 for “S₅-model”, while the “large” model bars range from approximately 85.8 for “Prefix” to 89.5 for “S₅-model”. The bars are grouped, with the “base” and “large” model bars positioned side-by-side for each fine-tuning method. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by any particular order.
